summary: 1x RTX PRO 6000 - RAM-cached base, STRICT gate+repair, MTP-1, graphs
serve_cmd:
docker run --rm \
  --name vllm-moet-bench-8794 \
  --gpus '"device=6"' \
  --network host \
  --ipc host \
  --shm-size 64g \
  -e PORT=8794 \
  -v /workspace/vllm-moet/bench/recipes/deepseek-v4-flash/pro6000x1-cache.yaml:/opt/vllm-moet/recipes/deepseek-v4-flash/pro6000x1-cache.yaml:ro \
  -v /workspace/vllm-moet/bench/models.yaml:/opt/vllm-moet/models.yaml:ro \
  -v /workspace/ds4flash-official:/models/DeepSeek-V4-Flash:ro \
  -v /workspace/moet-serve:/planes \
  -e PLANES_CACHE=/planes \
  -e PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True \
  -e NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1 \
  vllm-moet-recipes:v024-a220c5598 \
  deepseek-v4-flash/pro6000x1-cache
